newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates to increase flights to Nairobi.
newsitem.headline: Emirates to increase flights to Nairobi.

text.p: Emirates airline said on Thursday it would increase its flight frequency between Dubai and Nairobi to four times a week.
It currently operates flights to Nairobi on Mondays and Fridays. On October 29 it will start Tuesday flights and on December 8 it will begin Sunday flights.

All flights will be operated at the same times. They will depart Dubai at 1415 local time and arrive in Nairobi at 1810 The return flight leaves Nairobi at 1940 and arrives Dubai at 0140 the next day. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
